instruction: Question 2: How does the Attention Mechanism work in the Transformer model?

The attention weights of the heads are calculated using a self-attention mechanism. The self-attention mechanism in Transformer models considers all the available tokens in the sequence, and calculates the attention weights for each of the tokens based on the contextual information provided by the other tokens.
